QuestInfo.1: #bHard as Stone#k wasn't actually THAT curious about her grandfather's stories, she just wanted to be #rwith him#k. Let #bStands with Bulls#k know.
QuestInfo.2: #bHard as Stone#k wasn't actually THAT curious about her grandfather's stories, she just wanted to be #rwith him#k. Let #bStands with Bulls#k know.

0.1: But... I don't need this. I love his stories, but... I really just want to see my grandfather. He's the only family I have left.
0.2: It's too dangerous to go visit him... But I've got to see him somehow...

yes.0: I want to hear Grandfather's stories in his voice.\r\n#e#b(Talk to Stands with Bulls in Twilight Perion.)\r\n

no.0: I can't leave the refuge, though...

1.0: I was waiting for you! Was my granddaughter happy?\r\n#L0##b(I should tell him the truth...)#l\n#k

yes.0: I'm not here because I want to be. No true Perion warrior would willingly build anything for the Black Mage. I'm so ashamed of myself...
yes.1: Who would take care of my poor granddaughter if I didn't work? She's always been more frail than she lets on. I have to work to pay for her medicine.
yes.2: I thought I had cried my last tears when I watched my allies fall in the final battle... I didn't know I had any tears left. You have shown me that my heart is not made of stone... Thank you for helping out an old man... *cough* *cough*
yes.3: I hope we can all wake up into something better, so to speak.

npc.0: When can I see my grandfather? It's too dangerous for me to go to him... Can you ask him to come see me?\r\n#e#b(Talk to Stands with Bulls in Twilight Perion.)\r\n
